Every other Minesweeper on Android is either a privacy nightmare stuffed with ads and trackers, or a bare-bones port that looks like it was built in 2009. This one is neither.

• Screen shake on game over

• Haptic feedback on every interaction
• Deep-space dark theme with vibrant number colours

fdroid:org.simlar.name: Simlar - secure calls
fdroid:org.simlar.summary: Protect your privacy with encrypted phone calls.
fdroid:org.simlar.description:
Protect your privacy and make free mobile phone calls over the internet with Simlar. Your calls are fully encrypted and tap-proof. Simlar is very easy to use. Just select your contact and call them! After installation, all of your contacts who also use Simlar will be listed in the app automatically. Maybe some of your friends already have Simlar. If not, you can invite them easily. Simlar is also available for iPhones.
Simlar is based on the established end-to-end encryption protocol ZRTP. No one can listen to your conversation, not even us. During your first call, you need to match a short code with the person you are speaking to. This protects against man-in-the-middle attacks and only needs to be done once per contact.
The app development is driven by the open source community. You can find the source code at simlar.org.
Simlar is free of charge. All you need is an internet connection. The more stable it is, the better your sound quality. The average “traffic” corresponds to 1 megabyte for a 2-minute call. For more details see simlar.org.

 the battle-tested GnuPG and a modern, memory-safe Rust rPGP backend. It makes encryption, signing,
 and key management easier and more trustworthy in everyday privacy workflows.
 Easy: Encrypt and sign your texts, files and more.
 Cross-platform: Native support for Windows, macOS and Linux.
 Profiles: Keep separate sets of keys and settings, and switch between them.
 Portable: Run from a USB drive, or carry a profile in one encrypted file.
 Dual-engine: Switch freely between the mature GnuPG and the Rust rPGP backend.

 Privacy-focused: Using multiple approaches to enhance safety.

flathub:io.github.tobagin.Draughts.description:
Draughts is a comprehensive game featuring 16 international game variants,
 multiple AI difficulty levels, online multiplayer, and a modern interface.
 It offers engaging gameplay for players of all skill levels with support for local and
 online matches against friends or AI.
 Game Features:
 16 international variants including American, Russian, Brazilian, and Frisian
 10 AI difficulty levels from Beginner to Grandmaster
 Online multiplayer with quick match, private rooms, and session persistence
 Multiple board themes and piece styles
 Complete move history with undo/redo and PDN export
 The game ensures a polished experience with sound effects, keyboard navigation,
 high contrast modes, smooth animations, and game history replay. It also

 board orientation.

flathub:net.ptilouk.superfluous.description:
The unnecessary video game of the useless superhero: a humorous point-and-click adventure with cartoonish graphics. 
 The action takes place in Fochougny, a very quiet French village where the billionaire Harpagon Lonion lives. He regularly dresses up as Superfluous, a very useless superhero in such a peaceful countryside...
 Helped by his assistant Sophie, who tries to somehow temper the enthusiasm of her employer, he will try to put his hands on the mysterious apple thief who terrorizes the orchards of Fochougny...
 Can you identify this offender?
 Will you finally discover a criminal of your stature?
 Will you find him in this charming village?
 Features 
 Immerse yourself in a colorful universe in the style of a 2D cartoon
 Wander quietly through the village of Fochougny, an open world
 Solve puzzles, find secret codes, pick up items, combine them, talk to people from Fochougny to try to figure out what happened
 Play with the mouse in the pure tradition of point-and-click games, or choose gamepad or touchscreen controls
 Enjoy finely cut dialogues and omnipresent humor (the quality of the jokes is non-contractual)
 Relax playing a game where you can't lose, die or get stuck (but where you can to tear your hair out trying to solve some puzzles
 hair implants are not provided)
 Play at your own pace: with or without hints to help you progress
 Text dialogues available in English, French and Italian

flathub:org.b3log.siyuan.description:
A privacy-first personal knowledge management system, support fine-grained block-level reference
 and Markdown WYSIWYG
 Block editing: SiYuan, the only important core concept is Content block. The content block can
 be formed through the formatting format, so that we can organize our thoughts and knowledge at
 the block-level granularity, and it is also convenient for reading and outputting long content.
 Privacy security Encrypted cloud, worry-free privacy: Data is stored entirely on the device
 under the control of the user. Even if there is no network, even if the cloud service is down,
 it can still be used locally without restrictions. No offline, no notes.
 Bidirectional link: Documentation page are also blocks, reducing mental load. All content exists
 on a block basis, and documentation pages are no exception. Blocks can be converted to each other,
 splitting, reorganizing and moving do not affect existing links.
 List outline: Sort out the main points, logically layered
 Multi-device data sync: Keep data complete and consistent

HydraPaper is a wallpaper manager, specifically designed to work around the lack of functionality of many desktop environments to set a different wallpaper for each monitor in a multi monitor setup.  It currently supports various desktop environments, including GNOME, MATE, Cinnamon and Budgie. Experimental support is included for the sway window manager.

flathub:org.kde.kbruch.name: KBruch
flathub:org.kde.kbruch.description:
KBruch is a small program to practice calculating with fractions and percentages. Different
 exercises are provided for this purpose and you can use the learning mode to practice with fractions.
 The program checks the user's input and gives feedback.
 Features:
 Arithmetic exercise - in this exercise you have to solve a given fraction task. You have
 to enter the numerator and the denominator. This is the main exercise.
 Comparison exercise - in this exercise you have to compare the size of 2 given fractions,
 using the symbols >, < or =.
 Conversion exercise - in this exercise you have to convert a given number into a fraction.
 Factorization exercise - in this exercise you have to factorize a given number into its prime
 factors.
 Percentage exercise - in this exercise you have to calculate percentages.

 non-technical users.
 TeXworks is inspired by Dick Koch's award-winning TeXShop program for Mac OS X, which has made
 quality typesetting through TeX accessible to a wider community of users, without a technical or
 intimidating face. The goal of TeXworks is to deliver a similarly integrated, easy-to-use environment
 for users on other platforms, especially GNU/Linux and Windows.
 Among other things, TeXworks features an integrated PDF previewer, synchronization between the
 TeX files and the PDF output, and an extensible scripting interface.

firefox-addons:3048360.name: Konode | Private Bookmark & Tab Sync
firefox-addons:3048360.summary: Privacy-first browser sync to your own storage: Google Drive, WebDAV, GitHub.
firefox-addons:3048360.description:
Konode syncs your browser data to storage you own. There is no Konode server and no account to create. Your bookmarks go straight from your browser to your Google Drive, a GitHub repository, or your own WebDAV storage.
Konode is fully open source under the MPL-2.0 license. Read every line, audit exactly what it does with your data, or build it yourself:
 https://github.com/konabe-studio/konode 
 Bookmarks: full folder structure, adds, deletes, moves, and reorders
 Open tabs: save your session and restore another device's tabs
 History: a synced, de-duplicated list
 Extensions: see which extensions are missing on this device
Bookmarks sync on their own. History, tabs, and the extension list are optional, and each one asks for its permission only when you turn it on.
 Konode keeps restore points: timestamped copies of your bookmark tree, on your own storage, the newest ten kept. Save one whenever you like, and Konode saves one by itself if a sync ever arrives asking for an unusual mass deletion, which it refuses rather than carries out. Restoring only ever adds bookmarks back, so it can't cost you anything.
No Konode servers. Your data travels only between your browser and the storage backend you configure.
No telemetry, no analytics, no tracking of any kind.
Optional end-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM). You choose during setup, nothing is uploaded until you've decided. With encryption on, your storage provider can't read your data.
Credentials stay on your device, in the browser's extension storage.
Pick Google Drive, GitHub, or your own WebDAV storage. The setup wizard has a card for the popular WebDAV providers with the server address already set up, so there is nothing to look up. For any other server, there is the generic WebDAV option.
Konode's interface follows the language your browser is set to. English, Hungarian, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) are complete. More languages are in progress, and anyone can help without touching code, on Hosted Weblate:
 https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/konode/ 
Konode works with every Firefox-based browser. On Firefox for Android it syncs open tabs and the extension list only: Firefox for Android gives extensions no access to bookmarks or history, and Google sign-in does not work there, so use GitHub or WebDAV storage.
Each device writes its own sync file to a Konode folder on your backend and merges every other device's file, additively and deletion-aware, so 3+ devices converge without a central server. Settings lists the devices sharing your folder, and lets you forget one you no longer use. Conflicts can be resolved newest-wins, prefer-local, prefer-remote, or manually from the popup.
Full changelog in the repository: https://github.com/konabe-studio/konode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

firefox-addons:3014634.summary: Inspect and debug Zustand state stores in real-time with powerful developer tools. View state snapshots, track actions, analyze state changes, and use time-travel debugging to simplify debugging and improve development workflow.

🚀 Inspect and Debug Zustand State Stores in Real-Time
A powerful developer tool for monitoring, debugging, and managing Zustand stores with an intuitive and modern interface.
✨ Features
🔍 Real-Time State Inspection
Instantly view and monitor Zustand store data as your application updates.
🧠 State Snapshots
Capture and inspect complete state snapshots at every action dispatch.

Move backward and forward through state history to reproduce and debug issues effortlessly.
📦 Multiple Store Support
Manage and inspect multiple Zustand stores from a single dashboard.
🧾 Raw JSON Viewer
View the complete raw JSON state for deep debugging and data verification.
📊 State Difference Viewer
Quickly compare state changes with an easy-to-read diff panel.
📈 State Charts & Visualization
Visualize state transitions and updates for better understanding of application flow.
⏱ Performance Timer
Measure action execution timing and identify slow updates or bottlenecks.
🔎 Advanced State Search & Filtering
Quickly filter stores and search state values in real-time.
🎨 Clean & Developer-Friendly UI
Modern dark theme with a distraction-free debugging experience.
🛠 Built for Developers
Designed to simplify Zustand debugging, improve productivity, and speed up issue resolution.

firefox-addons:3035267.name: GitHub UI Translator
firefox-addons:3035267.summary: Translates the GitHub UI locally using bundled language dictionaries.
firefox-addons:3035267.description:
GitHub UI Translator is a browser extension that translates GitHub’s English interface into Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, French, or Russian using dictionaries bundled with the extension.
【Features】
■ Translation runs entirely in your browser
The extension does not use external translation APIs or cloud services. GitHub UI text is processed only in your browser. Page content is not recorded, stored, or transmitted externally.
■ Reduces the risk of mistranslating user-created content
The extension includes safeguards designed to help keep user-created or user-configured content out of translation, including README files, issues, pull requests, comments, code blocks, repository names, branch names, tag names, and label names.
It focuses on translating GitHub’s fixed UI text, such as navigation items, buttons, menus, and settings pages.
■ Supports nine languages
From the extension icon in the toolbar, you can select one of the following nine target languages:
・Japanese
・Simplified Chinese
・Traditional Chinese
・Spanish
・German
・Brazilian Portuguese
・Korean
・French
・Russian
When you change a setting, open GitHub tabs are automatically reloaded to apply the new configuration.
■ Easily turn translation on or off
You can turn all translations on or off at any time and return to GitHub’s original English interface. Global header translation can also be disabled separately.
【Current limitations】
・The extension translates fixed UI text registered in its bundled dictionaries. Unregistered text remains in English
・Dynamic text containing numbers or dates, such as “3 commits” or “opened 2 days ago,” may not be translated
・User-created content, including usernames, repository names, and posts, is excluded from translation in principle
・Changes to GitHub’s page structure may occasionally cause some user-created content to be translated unintentionally
・Only github.com is supported. GitHub environments on other domains, including GitHub Enterprise Server, are not supported
【Open source】
The project is released under the MIT License. Suggestions for translation additions and corrections are welcome.
 https://github.com/nobuo-miura/github-ui-translator

firefox-addons:3130989.name: Password Factory
firefox-addons:3130989.summary: Generate strong, random passwords instantly from the toolbar. Passwords are created locally with your browser's cryptographic random number generator.
firefox-addons:3130989.description:
Password Factory is a simple, lightweight password generator that lives in your browser toolbar. Click its icon to generate a strong, random password and copy it to your clipboard.
Unlike Firefox's built-in password generator, which is only available when interacting with a password field on a web page and cannot be accessed even from the Passwords management page ( about:logins ), Password Factory lets you generate strong passwords whenever you need them, without requiring an active password field.
All passwords are generated locally in your browser. Nothing is stored or transmitted, and there is no tracking or data collection.
◼ FEATURES 
 ● Generates strong random passwords from the toolbar popup.
 ● Uses the browser's cryptographic random number generator (crypto).
 ● Every password contains uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits and
  symbols.
 ● Adjustable password length from 16 to 128 characters (default 16).
 ● Optional reserved characters: ' ` [ ] { } / ; ? | " < >
 ● Passwords are generated locally and are never stored, logged or
  transmitted.
 ● No tracking and no data collection.
 ● Built on Manifest V3.
◼ PERMISSION JUSTIFICATION 
 ● "storage" – Saving your preferences (password length and reserved
  characters option) locally in the browser.

3D Anatomy for the Artist!
Unlock the secrets of the human body and elevate your artistic skills with 3D Anatomy for the Artist — the ultimate reference tool for artists, illustrators, and art students who want to draw the human figure with confidence and accuracy.
Whether you're a beginner or a professional, this app gives you everything you need to understand how muscles, bones, and body structures work together, so you can bring your drawings to life with realism and depth.
Key features:
- 3D Models: Explore fully interactive skeletal and musculoskeletal 3D models. Rotate, zoom, and examine the human body from every angle to understand anatomy like never before.
- Anatomical Drawings: Browse a rich library of detailed anatomical drawings and artistic sketches of muscles, perfect for study and inspiration.
- Reference Pictures: Access high-quality anatomical picture references showing muscles, bones, and structures in stunning detail.
- Photo References: Study real human body photos of models in various poses, ideal for capturing proportions, muscle definition, and natural movement.

1. Choose your reference type: 3D models, drawings, pictures, or photos.
